'''Centares''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Maldrood sector/Legends|Maldrood sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. It had a temperate climate and no [[Moon/Legends|moons]].

==Description==
It was located in the [[Maldrood sector/Legends|Maldrood sector]] on the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]] at the outermost edge of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]],<ref name="TEA" /> and billed itself as "the last civilized stop before the wild and woolly [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]". Its population was estimated to be about one billion.<ref name="tt" />

==History==
===Pre-Republic era===
For millennia, certain scholars believed Centares to be part of the historic [[Ash Worlds/Legends|Kiirium Reaches]] conquered by [[Xim's empire]] roughly a century prior to the founding of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. This was based on the prevalence of the name "[[OHS3842-03|Astigone]]"&mdash;a world noted in [[Tionese (group)/Legends|Tionese]] documents from the [[Pre-Republic era]]&mdash;among the world's luxury resorts. This theory was ultimately disproved when the [[Corellia/Legends|Corellian]] historian [[Bleys Harand]] uncovered evidence that the Kiirium Reaches were in fact the [[Ash Worlds/Legends|Ash Worlds]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="Xim">{{SW|url=news/essential-atlas-extra-the-history-of-xim-and-the-tion-cluster|text=Essential Atlas Extra: The History of Xim and the Tion Cluster|int=Xim Week: The History of Xim and the Tion Cluster}}</ref>

During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], an old [[Communications satellite]] was found nearby Centares. The satellite was surveilling and recording the [[Galaxy/Legends|intergalactic]] communication channels for centuries.<ref name="Mission">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Slicing|Watching and Listening}}</ref>

===Galactic Republic===
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Centares and the Maldrood sector seceded to the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="TEA" /> which its forces and Republic clashed in the [[Battle of Centares (Clone Wars)|Battle of Centares]] in the early stages of the Clone Wars.<ref name="RHNCE">{{InsiderCite|66|Republic HoloNet News Core Edition 14:3:22}}</ref>

===Galactic Empire===
In the waning days of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], Centares called itself "the jewel of the Mid Rim," drawing traders and tourists from across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. However, the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] tapped its lava beds and strip mined its magnificent prairies, turning it into a grimy, polluted factory world within a decade, when its resources expired and the Empire moved on. Centares endeavored to rebound, and its cities and spaceports like [[Muracie]] were still teeming, but no tourists were forthcoming.

Most representative of the depredations of the Empire was [[Rubyflame Lake]], which once held clear, shallow, geothermally-heated water colored red by suspended silica. After the Empire, the waters retained their reddish cast, but were tainted by pollutants capable of dissolving flesh in minutes.

From Centares, [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] tracked a [[House of Tagge/Legends|House of Tagge]] [[Mining Explorer]] to [[Achtnak Turbine Station]] on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]].<ref name="SW25">[[Star Wars (1977) 25|''Star Wars'' (1977) 25]]</ref>

It was on this planet that [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] defeated and thought he [[Duel on Centares|killed]] [[Beilert Valance/Legends|Beilert Valance]], inspiring [[Tyler Lucian]] to suicide rather than betray the name of Luke Skywalker to Vader.<ref name="SW29">[[Star Wars (1977) 29|''Star Wars'' (1977) 29]]</ref> Despite Lucian's sacrifice, Vader learned the name of Luke Skywalker from [[Thurlow Harris]] whom he interrogated on Centares.<ref name="vq" />

===Greater Maldrood and New Republic===
After the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], Centares became the capital of the [[Greater Maldrood]], an Imperial faction established by [[High Admiral]] [[Treuten Teradoc]].<ref name="TEA" />

When [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Zsinj]] was [[Battle of Dathomir (Hunt for Zsinj)|killed]], Teradoc declared himself "High Admiral of the Mid Rim" and found himself in the middle of a [[Post–Zsinj campaigns|war]] between Admirals [[Teren Rogriss]] of the Empire and [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Gial Ackbar]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Teradoc was eventually [[Battle of Centares (Galactic Civil War)|defeated]] by the New Republic forces and he was forced to abandon the Greater Maldrood to the New Republic and flee to the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]].<ref name="TEA" />

===Forever Crimson===
In [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]] a [[Wandering P'orp|salvage crew]] unknowingly uncovered Beilert Valance's remains at Rubyflame Lake while scavenging for parts, reactivating him years after his body went into a coma within the corrosive waters following his defeat by Darth Vader.<ref name="Star Wars 1977 108">[[Star Wars (1977) 108|Forever Crimson]]</ref>

===Yuuzhan Vong War===
In [[26 ABY/Legends|26 ABY]], the entire Maldrood sector was conquered by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] after four battles against the New Republic, including [[Battle of the Centares system|one]] on Centares.<ref name="TEA" />
